entries.name: ntalk
entries.note: Legacy talk (ntalk) messaging daemon. No Arch package ships it and no BifrOSt service or app uses the talk protocol, so the service has no meaning on BifrOSt.

entries.name: org.apache.httpd
entries.note: Apache web server comes from the Arch apache package (runtime-packages.txt). The unit is installed but not enabled by default; BifrOSt has no Settings surface for it. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The apache package from packaging/arch/runtime-packages.txt ships the web server and its systemd unit httpd.service. Unit name not verified on a built image.

entries.name: org.cups.cups-lpd
entries.note: Built: Printer Sharing switch (Settings > Sharing) enabling cups-lpd.socket, which hands each LPD connection to the packaged cups-lpd. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Built 2026-10-17: Printer Sharing. cups-lpd.socket listens on port 515 and starts cups-lpd@.service per connection, which runs the cups package's cups-lpd (queues the job through cupsd); Settings > Sharing gets a Printer Sharing switch that privd service.set maps to cups-lpd.socket (accounts::service_units). Off until the person turns it on.

entries.name: org.cups.cupsd
entries.note: The CUPS scheduler is the cups package; BifrOSt's CUPS and IPP client models and the Print Center app use it. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The CUPS scheduler comes from the cups package (cupsd and cups.service). BifrOSt's CUPS and IPP client models (cups.rs, ipp.rs) are tested against it and back the Print Center app.

entries.name: org.net-snmp.snmpd
entries.note: snmpd comes from the net-snmp package (runtime-packages.txt). It is not enabled by default and BifrOSt has no Settings surface for it. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The net-snmp package (runtime-packages.txt) ships the snmpd daemon and its unit snmpd.service. Unit name not verified on a built image.

entries.name: org.openldap.slapd
entries.note: slapd comes from the openldap package (runtime-packages.txt). It is not enabled by default and BifrOSt has no directory-service Settings surface. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The openldap package (runtime-packages.txt) ships the slapd directory server and its unit slapd.service. Unit name not verified on a built image.
